verdict.rationale: cubic has a built-in AI assistant you can delegate to. Tagging @cubic-dev-ai in PR comments asks questions, triggers reviews or an Ultrareview, and requests fixes. 'Fix with cubic' and auto-fix generate fixes and push them to the PR branch, and an AI chat answers questions about a PR using codebase context. Delegation is limited to review and fix work, though, and the in-product chat sidebar is documented only under an archive path. Missing for 10: delegation of tasks beyond code review and fixes, current (non-archived) docs for the in-product chat assistant, and independent hands-on corroboration of delegated fixes working.
